description: Tokens the app's functions use. Secret values are only readable by this app's functions, never by its users. Configure them in the app (Permissions Test, Problem notifications, Frontends) or here.

accountUuid.description: UUID of the Dynatrace account this environment belongs to (Account Management > Identity & access management > OAuth clients shows it).

oauthClientId.description: OAuth client of the account (dt0s02.…). Permissions Test: account-idm-read, iam:bindings:read, iam:policies:read, iam:boundaries:read. Generating platform tokens: platform-token:tokens:manage.

permissionsTestForAllUsers.displayName: Permissions Test for every app user
permissionsTestForAllUsers.description: Off: only users who can change this app's settings can run the Permissions Test (it reads the account's groups, policies and boundaries).

workflowsToken.description: Platform token (dt0s16.…) with automation:workflows:read and automation:workflows:write; Problem notifications creates the migration workflows with it.

workflowsTokenInfo.description: Who the token was generated for and when it expires (set by the app).

readConfigToken.description: Classic API token (dt0c01.…) with the ReadConfig scope; Frontends reads user tag rules with it.

readConfigTokenInfo.description: Who created the token and when it expires (set by the app).
